title: Head of GenAI Platform
description:
About us

Founded in 2019 and part of Y Combinator's 2020 cohort, Photoroom is the leading visual solution for e-commerce.

We've raised Series B funding and reached 300+ million users worldwide, processing over 5 billion images annually and serving both small businesses and major enterprises like Amazon, DoorDash, and Decathlon through our mobile app, web platform, and API.

We're a team of 100+ passionate builders giving e-commerce businesses superpowers to create visuals that help them grow, making the hardest parts of selling online disappear. We focus on craft, innovation, and collaboration to create exceptional impact for e-commerce businesses worldwide.

Head of GenAI Platform

Role Summary

We're looking for a Head of GenAI Platform to lead the strategy and technical direction behind Photoroom's generative AI platform, spanning model orchestration, evaluation, agentic workflows, and foundation model training, enabling our teams to ship breakthrough AI products faster than anyone else. You'll partner closely with our Infrastructure team on inference infrastructure and model serving, rather than owning that layer outright.

This is a highly strategic leadership role combining strong technical grounding, organisational leadership, and product thinking. Deep technical expertise already exists across our ML and Research teams, so we're not looking for the single deepest expert in the room, we're looking for someone who has been hands-on in ML or research themselves, understands the space well enough to lead a credible technical conversation and make sound calls, and can create the conditions for that expertise to thrive. You'll work closely with our CTO and senior leaders across Product and Engineering to shape how AI is built, deployed, and scaled across the company.

Compensation: Competitive salary + meaningful equity

Location: Paris, France (Hybrid)

Relocation: Visa sponsorship and relocation support up to €10,000 available

About the Role

You'll be responsible for building both the technical foundations and the organisation that enable Photoroom's next generation of AI products.

Your responsibilities will include:

•
Defining the long-term vision and technical strategy for our GenAI Platform around model orchestration, evaluation, agentic workflows and foundation model training

•
Partnering with our Infrastructure team on inference infrastructure, model serving and reliability, so the platform stays scalable and cost-efficient across billions of inference requests

•
Partnering with Research to rapidly bring new models into production

•
Leading and growing a multidisciplinary team of ML Engineers, Software Engineers and Researchers, setting direction for the team as a whole, while day-to-day management of individual contributors continues through the team's existing engineering leads

•
Creating an environment where ambitious technical ideas can move from research to production in days rather than months

•
Building evaluation frameworks that measure model quality, cost and latency consistently across the platform

•
Working closely with Product, Engineering and Executive leadership to ensure platform investments directly accelerate product innovation

What You'll Bring

We're looking for someone with strong technical grounding and proven leadership experience. You don't need to be the foremost technical authority in every area, as that depth already exists in the team, but you should have been a hands-on ML/research practitioner at some point in your career, ideally with some research experience, so you can lead the function credibly.

You'll likely have:

•
Significant experience leading Machine Learning or AI organisations within product-focused companies, having started your career as a hands-on ML engineer or researcher before moving into leadership

•
Experience building and operating AI platforms: model orchestration, evaluation pipelines or agent frameworks, with enough grounding in inference infrastructure and model serving to partner effectively with an Infrastructure team, without needing to own that layer directly

•
Strong technical expertise across Generative AI, Computer Vision or Foundation Models

•
A track record of taking emerging technologies from research into production systems used by millions of users. We don't expect deep, specific agentic-workflow experience, the field is relatively new and nobody has a long track record there, but we do want evidence you can effectively leverage new technologies to productise what's next

•
Experience growing high-performing engineering and research teams through hiring, coaching and organisational design

•
Enough technical depth to follow and meaningfully contribute to an architecture conversation outside your core area, you don't need all the answers, but you must understand the building blocks well enough to ask the right questions and make a call when needed

•
Strong product instincts and the ability to balance long-term technical investments against immediate customer impact

•
Excellent communication skills and experience partnering with Product, Engineering, Marketing and Executive stakeholders

What Success Looks Like

Within your first 12-18 months, you'll have:

•
Established a clear long-term strategy for Photoroom's AI platform

•
Built infrastructure that significantly reduces the time required to ship new AI capabilities

•
Enabled research teams to move new models into production rapidly and reliably

•
Improved platform performance, reliability and infrastructure efficiency at scale, in close partnership with the Infrastructure team

•
Built and retained a world-class team of ML Engineers, Researchers and Platform Engineers

•
Created evaluation frameworks that allow model quality, cost and latency to be measured consistently across the platform

•
Helped define the technical direction that underpins the next generation of AI-powered products at Photoroom

Why This Role Matters

Every AI capability at Photoroom depends on the platform your team builds.

From foundation model training to model orchestration, evaluation pipelines and production inference, you'll shape the technical backbone that enables our teams to innovate quickly while operating at massive scale.

This is an opportunity to influence both the long-term direction of our AI strategy and the systems that process billions of images every year.

About Photoroom

Photoroom was launched in 2020 after being accepted into Y Combinator and has grown into one of the world's leading AI photo editing platforms.

Today we have:

•
Over 300 million downloads

•
More than 5 billion images processed annually

•
Millions of active users across mobile, web and API

•
Customers ranging from individual creators to global brands including Amazon, Shopify, eBay, DoorDash, Decathlon and Depop

We're profitable, growing rapidly and continuing to invest heavily in AI research and product innovation. Our teams train our own foundation models, operate large-scale GPU infrastructure, and build AI products used every day by millions of people worldwide.

Working at Photoroom

We believe great people do their best work when given ownership, autonomy and ambitious problems to solve.

We offer:

•
Competitive salary and meaningful equity

•
Hybrid working from our Paris headquarters

•
Visa sponsorship and relocation support

•
MacBook Pro and full home office setup

•
30 days annual leave

•
Private healthcare

•
Regular company off-sites and team retreats

•
A collaborative, high-performance engineering culture focused on shipping impactful AI products

Hiring Process

•
Recruiter conversation

•
Leadership & values conversation with our CTO

•
Technical screening

•
Technical case study (working session)

•
Leadership and cross-functional interviews

•
References

•
Offer

Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging

We're committed to enabling everyone to feel included and valued at work. We believe our company and culture are strongest when composed of diverse experiences and backgrounds.

That's also why we have flexible working hours, trust people to work in a hybrid environment, and extended parental leave.

All qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, family, gender identity, marital status, national origin, physical or mental disability, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws.

title: Senior People Ops Manager (International)

The role

We are looking for a Senior People Operations Manager to own and improve the systems, processes and operational foundations behind our People function, across all of our markets.

You will own the core People Operations scope: payroll, HRIS, contracts, compliance, benefits, employee lifecycle operations, immigration, people data and our HR tooling. But this is not simply a role about running existing processes - your job is to make them better. You will build the people workflows, automation, documentation and self-service mechanisms that allow Photoroom to keep moving quickly as we grow, without creating unnecessary complexity.

This scope has so far sat within a small generalist People team. You will be the first person to own it as a dedicated senior scope, giving you the opportunity to shape this operating model.

We are also an AI-native company, and we want our People function to operate the same way. We expect you to actively use automation and AI to improve speed, reliability and employee experience, while maintaining a high bar for privacy, compliance and trust.

You will report to our VP People. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports today.

Why this role exists

We have built a lot quickly. Today, our People Operations environment includes:

•
French and USA payroll and entity obligations

•
European employees through an EOR setup

•
Growing Paris and New York offices

•
Multiple benefits providers and external partners

•
An HR technology stack that has grown alongside the company

The foundations work. Now they need a clear owner and regular improvements.

We want to move from processes that depend on individual knowledge and manual intervention to an operating model that is documented, automated, measurable and more self-service for our employees.

Your goal is to strengthen our foundations with proven best practices and build a model that scales comfortably with the company.

What you will own

Payroll

•
Own and Run monthly payroll for France and our European population, and twice-monthly US payroll, working closely with our external providers

•
Manage relationships with payroll, EOR and employment providers

Compliance

•
Maintain our French statutory obligations and HR compliance calendar, including employee records, social declarations, DUERP and employee data requirements

•
Own the operational administration of our CSE, including convocations, agendas, meeting preparation, PV review, annual budget administration and mandatory timelines

•
Monitor relevant employment law developments and translate changes into concrete actions

•
Coordinate compliance across our European and US setups, with deep expertise expected in France primarly

Contracts and People documentation

•
Employment contracts, amendments, offer letters, attestations and standard HR letters, maintaining and improving templates as our organisation and legal environment evolve

•
Setting clear service levels for recurring People Ops requests

•
Building practical People playbooks and documentation that employees and managers can actually find, understand and use

Employee lifecycle

•
Onboarding administration from signed offer through day one, coordinating payroll, benefits, declarations, IT access, equipment, manager actions ect..

•
Offboarding and exit administration, including documentation, payroll, benefits, access removal and final employment documents

•
Promotions, compensation changes, employment changes, contract amendments, leaves, parental leave and other employee changes

•
Immigration and visa administration, including external providers, applications, renewals and deadline tracking

Benefits & Compensation

•
Administer benefits and manage providers across France, Europe and the US

•
Run annual renewals with Finance and the VP People, using cost, usage and employee value to inform decisions

•
Support compensation benchmarking and salary band maintenance

HRIS, data and automation

Our HRIS is Hibob today, which may or may not change. You will own the reliability and evolution of our People systems.

This includes:

•
HRIS configuration, permissions, workflows, integrations and data quality

•
Making the HRIS the reliable source of truth for employee data

•
Assessing opportunities to consolidate or improve our HR technology stack

•
Automating repetitive workflows wherever doing so improves speed and reliability

Employee support

You will help us move from a People team that repeatedly answers standard questions to one that builds systems people can use themselves.

You will build the documentation, workflows, processes and self-service infrastructure that make the majority of standard People requests easy to solve without intervention, while personally handling the exceptions and escalations that genuinely require expertise.

What we are looking for

You have already owned a meaningful People Operations scope in a fast-moving company of +100 employees.

In particular, we are looking for:

•
Hands-on experience with French payroll and employment compliance

•
Experience owning People Operations processes, workflows, and controls

•
HRIS experience. Hibob is a plus, but experience configuring and improving a comparable system matters more

•
A systems mindset and a strong instinct for automation

•
Excellent operational judgement. You know which issues you can solve yourself and which require specialist advice

•
High standards of accuracy, discretion and follow-through

•
Comfort operating independently in a small team where you will both design the process and run it

•
Fluent French and English. English is our working language, while much of our payroll and employment law environment is French

•
Based in Paris and able to work from our office at least three days per week.

The person who will thrive here likes that combination: build it, simplify it, automate it and own it.

Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging

We're committed to enabling everyone to feel included and valued at work. We believe our company and culture are strongest when composed of diverse experiences and backgrounds.

That's also why we have flexible working hours, trust people to work in a hybrid environment, and extended parental leave.

description:
About us

Founded in 2019 and part of Y Combinator's 2020 cohort, Photoroom is the leading visual solution for e-commerce.

We've raised Series B funding and reached 300+ million users worldwide, processing over 5 billion images annually and serving both small businesses and major enterprises like Amazon, DoorDash, and Decathlon through our mobile app, web platform, and API.

Role Summary

We're looking for a Staff Product Manager to own the AI platform every Photoroom product is built on. Our mission is that any team ships best-in-class GenAI visuals without needing a backend engineer: the primitives, the gateway and the no-code tooling turn adding an AI capability into a configuration step rather than an engineering project. On top of that sits the agentic layer — multi-step visual workflows that generate, check, reason, route and publish on their own. Working closely with engineers, ML researchers, and the product teams who ship on your platform, you'll decide what gets built, why, and how it ships.

Location: Paris, (Hybrid)

About the role

•
Own the platform every AI feature runs through. Expand and improve our AI gateway, including safeguards, evals, cost and observability, giving teams the ability to ship with little to no code and build skills that we can ship directly to users.

•
Build the agentic layer and Photoroom’s MCP. Visual agents that run multi-step flows: generate, QA, route, retry, publish, all unattended and at catalog scale.

•
Define the problem before the solution. Sharpen the problem, then partner with engineering and research to ship work that feels effortless — for the developers and PMs using the platform as much as for end users.

•
Treat other teams as your customers. Every team's roadmap contains AI features gated on platform work. You'll prioritise across them, hold a strategy rather than a request queue, and say no with reasons.

•
Turn AI capabilities into products people want. Work hand-in-hand with our researchers and engineers to convert new model capabilities into shipped features that move usage and revenue, and turn them into primitives other teams can reuse.

•
Use data to decide, not to justify. Pull and interpret data yourself, such as adoption, latency, inference cost per successful generation, eval results. Form hypotheses, measure what shipped, and call what's next. You won't need to wait around for someone else to run the query.

About You

•
You've shipped products users love. 10+ years as a PM, with multiple launches where you have solved a user’s problem and delivered business outcomes.

•
You've built platform, infrastructure or developer-facing products. APIs, SDKs, internal platforms, ML infrastructure — products whose users are engineers.

•
You've shipped something agentic or model-backed into production. You understand evals, guardrails, non-deterministic output, cost per call, and what breaks when a multi-step flow runs unattended a million times.

•
AI has reshaped how you work. You use Claude or equivalent every day, for prototyping, testing with users, or automating the parts of the job that used to fill your calendar. The value you bring sits in strategy and direction, not in writing tickets.

•
You have demonstrable product taste. You can show specific work where the details matter and explain the calls you made, including the ones you'd make differently now. On a platform, taste shows up in the interface you make other people build against.

•
You create clarity from ambiguity. Given a fuzzy problem, you take action rather than waiting for direction: you structure it, decide what matters, and move.

•
You're data-fluent. You pull, interpret, and challenge data yourself, and use it to form a point of view rather than confirm one.

You thrive in small teams with high autonomy. You can ship without being managed, and can operate in a remote, async-first environment that offers no scaffolding around you.
